title: boerhavia triquetra var. intermedia
intro: Boerhavia triquetra var. intermedia, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a succulent plant native to India and Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and aiding in digestion. Devil's Claw has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and analgesic properties, which can help alleviate conditions like arthritis, muscle and joint pain, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant's bioactive constituents include iridoid glycosides, particularly harpagoside, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
